data.body: Post-merge review evidence: the normal review from the broad-fetch checkout made zero LLM calls and failed after 512.139s because `git fetch origin` hit the 300s timeout. The reusable probe correctly classified that row as unmatched/no-sidecar rather than treating it as a model-backed review. A normal retry from a main-only checkout completed with signed PASS at 813baac9b015: 28 LLM calls, deterministic 5.870s, LLM 109.148s, internal total 133.411s. The discriminating configuration difference is origin.fetch: the failing partial/promisor checkout fetches all origin heads and `resolve_ref(..., blobless=False)` invokes `git fetch --quiet --no-filter origin`, while the main-only checkout passed that boundary. This is evidence for a separate broad-fetch performance bug, not a duration attribution in the probe.
